purpose: Test whether V97-V107 failed because they moved only noncritical frontier work, while workflow completion is controlled by the current maximum remaining critical-path frontier player.

v107_mechanism_diagnosis.assignment_effect: Accepted changes in E890 and E892 propagated to thousands of later assignment hashes; all E891 scenario runs were assignment-equivalent to the V94 anchor despite shock activation.
v107_mechanism_diagnosis.outcome_effect: Across the six scenario-by-candidate comparisons, mean throughput changed by -0.343% to 0% and mean QPR by -0.0332% to +0.0476%; neither candidate passed any complete scenario gate.
v107_mechanism_diagnosis.interpretation: The causal gate was active and state changes were material, but moving lower-rank noncritical work did not improve workflow completion. More timing or safety gates on the same noncritical LoadLeast substitutions are not a new mechanism axis.

closed_axes.causal_shock_threshold_refitting: 3/2 and 2/1 failed V107; V108 fixes 3/2 and does not select on threshold

hypothesis.primary: A critical-frontier move can improve workflow completion only when an outcome-blind service-time proxy shows a material reduction on the moved critical player. V105-V107 protected those players categorically and therefore could not test this direct completion-path opportunity.
hypothesis.arm_a: During a causally observed 3/2 arrival shock, allow only current maximum-rank critical-frontier substitutions whose service-time proxy is at most 90% of the paired V94 anchor-node proxy.
hypothesis.arm_b: Use the same rule with a stricter at-most-80% proxy threshold.
hypothesis.falsification: The hypothesis fails if neither candidate passes every paired throughput and both QPR gates in all three E3 scenarios on the complete fresh E893-E895 cohort.

allowed: request identifiers first observed by the online scheduler at or before the current frame
the scheduler's bounded 100-frame first-seen-request count history
immutable DAG edges and current per-request schedulable frontier
immutable function CPU work, output size, and cold-start duration
current node CPU capacity, CPU and memory utilization, runnable, pending, resident, and same-window projected work
current warm-container state, completed-parent placement, and current directed bandwidth
current placement-feasible set and partial assignment state
frozen tape, SLA, reference, V94 score, OCS, and immutable-baseline-welfare certificates
forbidden: completion count, throughput, latency, cost, QPR, SLA, or request completion status beyond parent readiness already required for scheduling
future arrivals, future completion, future container state, or future child placement
workload scenario, burst label, seed identity, or registered burst interval as a routing input
confirmation-seed outcomes before a training pass
information_boundary.arrival_definition: Exactly the frozen V107 first-seen ReqId definition.
information_boundary.shock_definition: Exactly the frozen V107 80-frame baseline plus 20-frame recent window, minimum 20 requests in each, exact 3/2 integer-rate comparison, and 100-frame activation horizon.
information_boundary.service_time_proxy_frames: parent_transfer=sum(parent_output_mb/current_bandwidth) for remote completed parents; cold_start=0 for a running warm container and the immutable full cold-start duration otherwise; compute=(current pending+runnable+resident+same-window projected request count+1)*function_cpu_work/node_cpu_capacity; proxy=parent_transfer+cold_start+compute
information_boundary.proxy_claim_boundary: This is a deterministic current-state service-time proxy, not a prediction of observed completion latency. Every missing, nonfinite, nonpositive-capacity, or malformed input fails closed.

candidate_mechanism.eligible_players: Only every tied maximum immutable remaining critical-path-rank player on each request's current schedulable frontier; every noncritical player preserves its V94 anchor node.
candidate_mechanism.candidate_order: Increasing finite service-time proxy, then NodeId; anchor excluded from alternatives.
candidate_mechanism.individual_certificate: Candidate is placement-feasible, meets the arm's exact service-proxy ratio, never moves a warm anchor to a nonwarm candidate, has nonworse completed-parent locality, nonworse locality to every currently warm immediate-child container, nonworse CPU headroom, nonworse memory headroom, and nonworse routed terminal-OCS/nonterminal-FaaSRank score.
candidate_mechanism.complete_assignment_certificate: At least one critical substitution, strictly lower summed critical service proxy, nonworse complete routed-expert score, nonworse complete OCS score, and nonworse paper social welfare at immutable baseline prices.
candidate_mechanism.density_policy: Retain V107's nonterminal queue-density floor of 8. During the fixed 3/2 shock-active interval bypass the closed upper-density threshold; while inactive dispatch exact V94.
candidate_mechanism.coordination_acceptance: Exact frozen V94 dual window-safe proposal guard without a LoadLeast certificate.
candidate_mechanism.reference_policy: Policy-independent offline reference construction remains unchanged.
candidate_mechanism.exact_anchor_invariant: Without sufficient arrival history, without an active shock, without a certified critical substitution, or on any invalid proxy input, dispatch exactly V94 for identical current state and candidates.

per_window: critical player count, candidate evaluation count, substitution count, and proxy-input-unavailable count
anchor and alternative summed critical service proxy and delta
minimum and maximum accepted per-substitution proxy ratios
performance fields retained but not opened before joint blind audit

selection_rule.throughput_gate_per_scenario: candidate three-seed mean is at least the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is nonnegative on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.qpr_gate_per_scenario_per_convention: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is strictly positive on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.E3_winner_requires: one candidate passes all three metrics in all three E3 scenarios
selection_rule.multiple_passers: maximize the minimum relative mean QPR gain, then minimum relative throughput change, then prefer the stricter 4/5 service-proxy threshold, then arm_id
selection_rule.absolute_formal_n20_baseline_gates: diagnostic only and never used to select a V108 profile
